_source: Real mainnet transactions, read 2026-11-20 with getTransaction (jsonParsed) from a public node, of four coins: PAPI (a pool), $LA BEAST (pump.fun's curve), HCAT (pump.fun) and ACRES (Meteora DBC's curve).

Each is laid out as `parsed` of Helius Parsed Events by the rules Helius publishes (docs/parsed-events/parsed-response, read 2026-11-20): nativeTransfers are System Program transfer and create_account plus a synthetic transfer for SPL Token close_account; tokenTransfers are transfer, transfer_checked, burn, mint_to and their kin. The same layout of transaction 5xSKzM8b… reproduces Helius's own published answer for it field for field (`published`, which is that answer itself, its `instructions` left out for size).
`instructions` holds only pump.fun's own event of the trade: its `rawData` is the chain's instruction data, the same base58 text Helius gives (checked on the published answer).

`summary` is not on the chain and Helius's own was not recorded (the scan needs the deployment's key): where a record has one it is an assumption — Helius names a swap through Jupiter and through pump.fun a swap. Records with `summary: null` are read with no help from it.
`chain` is what the transaction's balances before and after say changed for the trader — the measure the reading is checked against.

usdtSale.note: A sale through Jupiter paid in USDT.

poolBuy.note: A buy in a pool paid in SOL.

poolSale.note: A sale in a pool for SOL.

relayedSale.note: A sale whose fee a relayer paid: the fee payer holds none of the coin.

curveSale.note: A sale on pump.fun's curve: the curve pays the SOL out of its own account, no transfer shows it.

curveRelayedSale.note: A sale on pump.fun's curve whose fee a relayer paid.

dbcBuy.note: A buy on Meteora DBC's curve.

tinyBuy.note: Two hundred tokens bought with a fixed fee on top: what the wallet paid is twenty times the market price.

custodyBuy.note: A bot's buy paid from its program's own account: the wallet itself paid only a tip.

custodySale.note: A bot's sale whose SOL went to its program's own account: the wallet got nothing.
